text:
alicia: Ran the hybrid-quant sweep on the new ranker (rf-7b-v2) against prod_holdout this morning.
ben: TL;DR numbers?
alicia: NDCG@10 down ~1.8% (conf int excludes 0), MRR@10 up ~0.9. short-query slice (<=5 tokens) is driving the NDCG loss.
chandra: hybrid-quant = float KV + int8 weights, right? any model artifacts?
alicia: yep weights=INT8, KV cache left in FP16. also tried nf4 and 4-bit symmetric. nf4 had similar MRR bump but less NDCG drop.
eva: drop on short queries makes me suspect tokenization/prefix truncation. did you keep the preproc identical to float run?
alicia: preproc script same commit hash. sanity-checked token counts, no obvious shift. but when I re-run with explicit `context_padding=8` the short-query gap shrinks.
mike: can you paste the eval command you ran?
alicia: sure:
```
python -m eval.run \
  --model rf-7b-v2-hybrid-INT8 \
  --holdout prod_holdout \
  --metrics ndcg@10,mrr@10 \
  --slices short_query,long_query \
  --seed 42 \
  --bootstrap 1000
```
chandra: bootstrap 1000 gives CI, what p-values look like paired? any paired-bootstrap comparisons?
alicia: paired bootstrap p=0.02 for NDCG drop, p=0.12 for MRR increase. distributions overlap but median shifts.
ben: are top-k differences concentrated on rank positions 1-3 or later?
alicia: mostly rank 4-10 for short queries, top-1 stable. suggests reranker still gets best candidate but ordering after that degrades.
eva: could be numerical precision in dot product when scores are close. KV in fp16 preserves context, but int8 weights may change score spread.
mike: proposal: 1) rerun with more seeds (3 seeds), 2) run per-query paired delta and report fraction worse/better, 3) evaluate with larger beam of candidates (k=200) to see pruning interaction.
alicia: agreed. I'll kick off jobs, including variant that quantizes only the MLPs and leaves attention weights in fp16.
chandra: also add tiny synthetic set where we canonicalize doc formatting (strip punctuation, normalize whitespace) to check formatting sensitivity.
ben: if formatting normalization closes gap then we know it's preproc fragility, not quant instability.
deploy-bot: Job 6173456791 started: eval-hybrid-int8-seed1 (rf-7b-v2-hybrid-INT8) — status: queued.
alicia: thanks. I'll post raw diffs and a small sample of failure cases once jobs finish. quick ask: anyone has time to sanity-check a couple of short-query examples tomorrow?
eva: I can look after lunch.
mike: I'll help with the paired stats and CI tooling.
alicia: cool. goal is decide whether to ship hybrid-int8 for dedicated pools or hold until we find mitigation.
chandra: add a metric for "rank instability" (fraction of queries with any change in top10) — might help quantify ordering noise.
alicia: good call. adding that to the runs now. will update thread with results.
